newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Argentina's YPF rises.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Argentina's YPF rises.

text.p: Argentine oil company YPF SA rose Friday to highlight trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
YPF rose 1/2 to 27-7/8 after it reported first quarter earnings per share rose to 0.63 peso from 0.41 peso in the same period last year.
YPF was among the most-active ADRs. Volume was 1.4 million shares in early afternoon, three times normal daily trade.
Lucia Skwarek, head of Latin American equities at UBS Securities, said YPF had been trailing most Argentine stocks recently and Friday's move meant it was catching up with the pack.

"Argentine stocks (also) are doing better on the back of the Dow and the long bond," she said. The Dow industrials were up at midday and bonds, although weaker Friday on mixed signals from April's employment report, have recently rallied on signs of a federal budget deal and a slowing economy.
She said YPF also was helped by Standard & Poors' decision late in April to raise YPF's and several other companies' credit ratings to investment grade -- a first for Argentina.

Portuguese ADRs moved higher because of Morgan Stanley Capital International's decision to upgrade Portugal to the developed from the emerging market, traders said. The firm's indices are widely followed by fund managers.
Portugal Telecom SA rose 1-1/8 to 39 and Banco Comercial Portugues was up 1-1/8 to 16-7/8.

British multinationals rose on sterlings' weakness in the political transition after Labour's sweeping victory. British Steel Plc rose one to 23-3/4 and news and information company Reuters Holdings Plc was up 1-5/16 to 66.
However, British utilities eased amid worries about a possible windfall tax on privatized companies, traders said. PowerGen fell 1-7/8 to 41.
Japanese blue-chips strengthened. Honda Motor Co rose 1-7/8 and Toyota Motor Co was up 2-3/8 to 60-3/8 after they reported higher April U.S. sales.
Advancers led decliners 314 to 185 among 806 ADRs. The ADR group rose 0.61 percent in early afternoon and volume was 43 million ADRs.
